sn47.41:1.1: dasāti || || Sāvatthi || || Catusu bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharatha || mā vo amatam panassa || katamesu catusu || || Idha bhikkhave kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || Imesu bhikkhave catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā viharatha || mā vo amatam panassā ti || ||
